Read ICA-AROMA mixing matrices and component classifications for MEDuSA denoising

Source: R/fmriprep_bids.R
read_fmriprep_aroma.Rd

Ingests fMRIPost-AROMA (*_desc-melodic_mixing.tsv + *_desc-aroma_metrics.tsv), legacy fMRIPrep <= 23.0 (*_desc-MELODIC_mixing.tsv + *_AROMAnoiseICs.csv), or in-memory MELODIC mixing matrices and component classifications into a run-aligned "medusa_aroma" bundle for apply_aroma, read_fmriprep_confounds, and read_fmriprep_subject.

Usage

read_fmriprep_aroma(
  mixing,
  classification = NULL,
  bold = NULL,
  run_names = NULL,
  na_strings = c("n/a", "N/A", "NA", ".", "NaN", "")
)

Arguments

mixing

Character vector of MELODIC mixing file paths (*_desc-melodic_mixing.tsv, *_desc-MELODIC_mixing.tsv, .tsv.gz, .csv), a single numeric T x K matrix or data.frame (single run), or a list of per-run T x K matrices / data.frames.

classification

Component classification specification identifying rejected motion components:

  • NULL (default when mixing is file paths): auto-discovers sibling *_desc-aroma_metrics.tsv(.gz) or *_AROMAnoiseICs.csv files in the same directory as each mixing file.

  • Character vector of paths to *_desc-aroma_metrics.tsv (classification == "rejected") or *_AROMAnoiseICs.csv (comma-separated 1-based component indices; empty file indicates zero rejected components).

  • Single 1-based integer vector (e.g., c(2L, 5L)), logical mask of length K (TRUE = rejected), or metrics data.frame with a classification column (for single-run inputs), or a per-run list of any of these.

bold

Optional "medusa_nifti_ts" object, named list of run BOLD matrices, single BOLD matrix, or character vector of run names used to validate acquisition entities, align run ordering, and verify volume counts.

run_names

Optional explicit character vector of unique run names when bold is NULL.

na_strings

Character vector of missing-value tokens passed to data.table::fread. Default c("n/a", "N/A", "NA", ".", "NaN", "").

Value

An S3 list of class "medusa_aroma" containing:

  • mixing: Run-named list of finite T x K numeric MELODIC mixing matrices.

  • noise_ics: Run-named list of 1-based integer vectors of rejected motion component indices.

  • signal_ics: Run-named list of 1-based integer vectors of accepted signal component indices.

  • metrics: Run-named list of per-component classification data.frames.

  • summary: Per-run data.frame summarizing volume counts and accepted/rejected component counts.

Details

Both headerless MELODIC mixing TSVs (standard FSL/fMRIPost-AROMA format) and headered TSV/CSV tables are detected automatically. BIDS file inputs are matched to bold runs using acquisition entities (sub-, ses-, task-, acq-, dir-, run-) without requiring template space- or res- tags to match, since fMRIPost-AROMA derives run-level MELODIC timecourses in MNI152NLin6Asym (res-2) regardless of the analysis output space.

See also

apply_aroma, read_fmriprep_subject, read_fmriprep_confounds

Examples

f_mix <- tempfile("sub-01_task-mid_run-01_", fileext = "_desc-melodic_mixing.tsv")
f_met <- sub("_desc-melodic_mixing\\.tsv$", "_desc-aroma_metrics.tsv", f_mix)
mix_mat <- matrix(rnorm(30 * 4), nrow = 30, ncol = 4)
utils::write.table(mix_mat, f_mix, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
met_df <- data.frame(
  IC = 1:4,
  classification = c("accepted", "rejected", "accepted", "rejected")
)
utils::write.table(met_df, f_met, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

ar <- read_fmriprep_aroma(f_mix)
ar
#> <medusa_aroma> 1 run | 2/4 total component(s) classified as rejected
#>   run n_volumes n_components n_accepted n_rejected pct_rejected
#>  run1        30            4          2          2           50
unlink(c(f_mix, f_met))
